mapper.insert: /* CompanyProvisionMapper.copyAuthMenuFromTemplate */ INSERT INTO tb_syst_auth_menu ( CMPNY_CD, AUTH_CD, MENU_D_ID, USE_YN, INSERT_NO, INSERT_DATE, UPDATE_NO, UPDATE_DATE ) SELECT #{newCmpnyCd}, AUTH_CD, MENU_D_ID, USE_YN, #{gvUserCd}, NOW(), #{gvUserCd}, NOW() FROM tb_syst_auth_menu WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{srcCmpnyCd} AND AUTH_CD IN ('master', 'hr', 'safe', '99999') AND USE_YN = 'Y'

/* CompanyProvisionMapper.copyBaimValDFromTemplateRenumber */ INSERT INTO tb_baim_val_d ( CMPNY_CD, BAIM_VAL_CD, BAIM_VAL_D_CD, BAIM_VAL_D_NM, SORT_IDX, USE_YN, VAL_D_INFO_1, VAL_D_INFO_2, VAL_D_DESC, INSERT_NO, INSERT_DATE, UPDATE_NO, UPDATE_DATE ) SELECT #{newCmpnyCd}, BAIM_VAL_CD, LPAD(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BAIM_VAL_CD ORDER BY SORT_IDX), 5, '0'), BAIM_VAL_D_NM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BAIM_VAL_CD ORDER BY SORT_IDX), USE_YN, VAL_D_INFO_1, VAL_D_INFO_2, VAL_D_DESC, #{gvUserCd}, NOW(), #{gvUserCd}, NOW() FROM tb_baim_val_d WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{srcCmpnyCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND BAIM_VAL_CD != 'COM005'

/* CompanyProvisionMapper.copyBaimValDPreserveAuth */ INSERT INTO tb_baim_val_d ( CMPNY_CD, BAIM_VAL_CD, BAIM_VAL_D_CD, BAIM_VAL_D_NM, SORT_IDX, USE_YN, VAL_D_INFO_1, VAL_D_INFO_2, VAL_D_DESC, INSERT_NO, INSERT_DATE, UPDATE_NO, UPDATE_DATE ) SELECT #{newCmpnyCd}, BAIM_VAL_CD, BAIM_VAL_D_CD, BAIM_VAL_D_NM, SORT_IDX, USE_YN, VAL_D_INFO_1, VAL_D_INFO_2, VAL_D_DESC, #{gvUserCd}, NOW(), #{gvUserCd}, NOW() FROM tb_baim_val_d WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{srcCmpnyCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM005'

/* CompanyProvisionMapper.seedCmmSeqFromBaimValD */ INSERT INTO tb_cmm_seq ( CMPNY_CD, SEQ_KEY, CURR_VAL ) SELECT #{newCmpnyCd}, BAIM_VAL_CD, MAX(CAST(BAIM_VAL_D_CD AS UNSIGNED)) FROM tb_baim_val_d WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{newCmpnyCd} AND BAIM_VAL_CD != 'COM005' GROUP BY BAIM_VAL_CD
